MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

2. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

3. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 14

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

11. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
